message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on steel collars (bushing sleeves) for control arms. Parts and accessories of motor vehicles fall under 8708.80 (suspension systems and parts), and 8708.80.65 covers other suspension parts, with 8708.80.6590 being the other-parts line.

Chapter 87 note: parts of general use (Section XV note 2, e.g., headings 7307) are excluded from Section XVII under Note 2(a). A steel collar could be a tube or pipe fitting (7307), but a collar of specific shape that is turned and formed is more likely a dedicated suspension part. I recall rulings on "control arm bushing sleeves" being classified in 8708.80.65. The steel collars are specially shaped for use in the control arm bushing, so they are parts of suspension systems.

The current 8708.80 breakdown is 8708.80.65 "Other: Suspension systems and parts thereof: Other", with statistical suffix 8708.80.6590 for other parts. The 8708.80.65 line covers "Other", and the 9000 suffix would be used in some versions. I will go with 8708.80.6590.

{"hts_code": "8708.80.6590", "reason": "The specially shaped steel collars are dedicated components that will be encased in rubber bushings for vehicle control arms, so they are parts of suspension systems of passenger vehicles under heading 8708, subheading 8708.80."}
